title: Edit Fundamentals
description: Assemble a timeline with confident in and out points, ripple trims and clean hard cuts.

title: Pacing Control
description: Shape tension with shot duration and cut density instead of cutting on autopilot.

title: Color Correction
description: Balance exposure and white point across shots using waveform and vectorscope.

title: Color Grading
description: Build a deliberate look on a corrected baseline and keep it consistent across a sequence.

title: Blender Navigation
description: Move around the viewport, switch modes and apply transforms without fighting the tool.

title: Box Modeling
description: Build clean topology from primitives using extrude, loop cuts and modifiers.

title: UV and Texturing
description: Unwrap a mesh with sensible seams and map textures without stretching.

title: PBR Shading
description: Describe surfaces with roughness, metallic and normal inputs that behave physically.

title: Lighting
description: Shape a subject with key, fill and rim, and control shadow softness through source size.

title: Rendering
description: Choose samples, denoising and output settings that trade render time for quality on purpose.

title: Keyframing
description: Set keys and read F-curves so timing is designed rather than discovered by accident.

title: Easing and Weight
description: Use anticipation, overshoot and settle so motion reads as having mass.

title: Rigging
description: Build armatures, weights and controls that let a mesh be posed without tearing.

title: Character Animation
description: Animate a rig in poses with clear silhouettes, arcs and readable timing.

title: Framing and Composition
description: Choose shot size, headroom and lens length that place the audience where the story needs them.

title: Camera Movement
description: Move the camera with intent, starting and ending on frames worth holding.

title: Coverage and Continuity
description: Plan shots that cut together, keeping screen direction and the action line intact.

title: Audio Capture
description: Record clean dialogue with headroom, usable room tone and a controlled noise floor.

title: Sound Design
description: Layer dialogue, effects, ambience and music so each element has a distinct job.

title: Mixing and Loudness
description: Balance a mix to a loudness target with ducking rather than brute level pushes.

title: Compositing
description: Combine elements with alpha, spill suppression and render passes in a linear working space.

title: VFX Integration
description: Match lighting, grain and perspective so a synthetic element sits inside the plate.

title: Story Structure
description: Build setup, turn and payoff that survive compression into short form.

title: Visual Storytelling
description: Carry meaning through image, sound and cut instead of explaining it in narration.

title: Montage Craft
description: Build a sequence that carries meaning through juxtaposition alone — no narration, no title cards, only the order of shots.

title: Signature Edit
description: Carry one recognisable editorial voice through a whole piece: rhythm, transitions and colour read as a single hand.

title: Procedural Shading
description: Drive materials from node graphs instead of hand-painted maps so one asset re-skins without a new texture pass.

title: Look Development
description: Drive a shot from blockout to final frame in Blender, holding one material and lighting language across every asset.

title: Motion Physics
description: Give weight, overlap and follow-through to a moving body so the curve reads as mass rather than interpolation.

title: Performance Animation
description: Animate a full beat of acting — intent, hesitation and reaction — instead of a technically clean move.

title: Lens Craft
description: Choose focal length, height and distance on purpose so each shot places the audience exactly where the scene needs them.

title: Camera Language
description: Design a shot list whose sizes, lenses and movement form a deliberate grammar the audience can follow.

title: Dialogue Editing
description: Clean, time and match spoken takes so a cut conversation sounds like one continuous room.

title: Final Mix
description: Deliver a mix that holds its loudness target and stays intelligible on phone speakers and headphones alike.

title: Match Moving
description: Solve a camera from the plate so a synthetic element stays locked to the scene through the whole move.

title: Invisible Effects
description: Place a synthetic element a viewer never questions: grain, motion blur and edge treatment all match the plate.

title: Thematic Structure
description: Shape an act break so the theme turns with the plot instead of being announced beside it.

title: Authorship
description: Write and deliver a short piece whose theme is visible in its structure, not stated in narration.
